expectations.text: Initial report: within 4 hours of classification AND no later than 24 hours from awareness
expectations.evidence: 'within 4 hours of classifying the incident as major, and no later than 24 hours from the moment the entity became aware'

expectations.text: Intermediate report: within 72 hours from submission of the initial notification
Final report: no later than one month from the (latest) intermediate report
expectations.evidence: 'within 1 month of the latest updated intermediate report'

expectations.text: States the weekend/bank-holiday relief: next working day by noon (with the carve-out for significant credit institutions)
expectations.evidence: Hedged and partly wrong: no 'by noon' stated, scope given as 'I am not certain of the exact scope', and carve-out described loosely as credit institutions/CCPs/trading venues rather than the significant-credit-institution carve-out for initial/intermediate reports

expectations.text: Cites CDR (EU) 2025/301 as the source of the time limits
expectations.evidence: 'timings are set in Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2025/301'
